title: Ballistic
description: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

title: Almost Famous
description: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour.

title: Noah
description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: The Outsiders
description: In the 1960s Oklahoma a sensitive youth gets in over his head when his best friend kills a member of a rival gang.

title: Risky Business
description: A call-girl helps a Princeton applicant turn his home into a one-night brothel.

title: Top Gun
description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

title: Horrible Bosses
description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

title: A Bad Moms Christmas
description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

title: Tommy Boy
description: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

title: Best in Show
description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

title: The King's Speech
description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

title: The Godfather
description: Crime boss Vito Corleone and his sons, the ruthless yet loyal members of the Corleone family, rule their secretive New York empire with an iron fist.

title: Rush Hour
description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

title: Rush Hour 2
description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

title: We're the Millers
description: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

title: True Grit
description: A teenage girl (Hailee Steinfeld) enlists the aid of a boozy, trigger-happy lawman (Jeff Bridges) to hunt down her father's killer (Josh Brolin).

title: Saving Private Ryan
description: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: Behind Enemy Lines
description: A Navy admiral (Gene Hackman) orders the rescue of a fighter pilot (Owen Wilson) after the Serbs shoot down his plane in Bosnia.

title: Troy
description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

title: Rush Hour 3
description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

title: The Intern
description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: Yellowjackets
description: A team of talented high school girls soccer players survives a plane crash deep in the remote northern wilderness.

title: Dexter: Resurrection
description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: The Foreigner
description: A businessman embarks on a revenge-fueled vendetta after his daughter dies in a terrorist bombing. His search leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers.

title: Baby Driver
description: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

title: Pike River
description: On Nov. 19, 2010, a coal mine explosion in New Zealand kills Anna Osborne's husband and Sonya Rockhouse's son, along with 27 other men. The two women soon embark on a quest for truth and justice, leading to change they never thought possible.

title: Snoopy, Come Home
description: The "Peanuts" gang becomes upset when the beloved beagle decides to leave home in search of his roots.

title: Dreamgirls
description: After an ambitious manager (Jamie Foxx) gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost.

title: Ghost
description: A slain Manhattan yuppie (Patrick Swayze) reaches out to his lover (Demi Moore), with a medium (Whoopi Goldberg) as his middle woman.

title: A Bad Moms Christmas
description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

title: Happy Christmas
description: An immature party girl (Anna Kendrick) moves in with her brother's family to get over a breakup and throws their lives out of whack.

title: Molly's Game
description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

title: Horrible Bosses
description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

title: Office Christmas Party
description: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

title: A Bad Moms Christmas
description: As if creating the perfect Christmas for their families isn't hard enough, under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla will have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers during the holidays.

title: Bad Santa 2
description: Fueled by cheap whiskey and greed, a foulmouthed criminal (Billy Bob Thornton), his mean mother (Kathy Bates) and their angry sidekick (Tony Cox) conspire to bilk a Chicago charity on Christmas Eve.
